case_number: 2024 INSC 392; CIVIL APPEAL NO.6135 OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP (Civil) No.4106/2021)
summary: Compulsory retirement as punishment under CRPF Act; whether justified when not explicitly listed in Section 11; High Court held Section 11 specifies enumerated punishments only; Supreme Court examined Section 11 read with Rule 27 of CRPF Rules, 1955; found compulsory retirement permissible under Rule 27 as lesser penalty than dismissal; overturned High Court; restored authority's disciplinary judgment; standard: statutory interpretation of permissible punishments.
legal_provisions_cited: Central Reserve Police Force Act, 1949 s.11
Central Reserve Police Force Act, 1949 s.18
Central Reserve Police Force Rules, 1955 Rule 27
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; compulsory retirement order restored; original disciplinary decision upheld.
